test_item:
The software shall provide a Binder-based interface via the Android Java Service to allow external components (specifically the DIAG service) to query the current key installation status (e.g., INSTALLED, ERROR, etc.).
(installation completed; the status is INSTALLED (2))
pre: 1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
proc:
1. Read the installation state file in the secure partition
$ adb shell od -t x1 /mnt/vendor/oemkeys/<installstate file>
2. PENDING: X-f-2 KeyInstall status test runner
er:
1. The adb shell od -t x1 /mnt/vendor/oemkeys/<installstate file> output shows the installstate value 2
2. PENDING: X-f-2 KeyInstall status test runner
